tests.name: ORB widget init declares surface + view_role on both init paths
tests.reason: The auth-change re-init now spreads orbViewProfile(route, role) like the main init; the gateway's orb.session.profile.resolved for a session started right after login reports resolution=declared instead of route. Proven in CI (static source + unit); staging is read-only and starting a voice session there is a production write.
